title: Duplicate-Aware Evaluation of NetFlow Intrusion Detection: A Hash-Group-Disjoint Protocol for the NF-v2 Datasets (code, notebooks and result files)
description: Standalone implementation of the hash-group-disjoint split protocol (nfdup), the Google Colab notebooks that produced the experiments, and the result files of the paper. Datasets are not redistributed.
